## Mouser v3.7.15 - startup and background stability fix

This is an unofficial fork build based on [TomBadash/Mouser](https://github.com/TomBadash/Mouser).

### Fixed

- Fixed a QML parsing error in the Mouse & Profiles page connection status text.
- The v3.7.14 Windows package could log FATAL: Failed to load QML and close
  before the window appeared. v3.7.15 loads the UI normally again.
- Reduced automatic background battery polling while the Mouser window is hidden
  or the system is idle, so Logitech wireless receivers are disturbed less often.

### Kept from v3.7.14

- Settings backup/export/import remains available from Settings.
- Mouser still keeps local rolling backups before config saves.
- Exported settings bundles still contain only config.json and metadata.json.

### Privacy / migration notes

- Public source and release packages do not include personal config, logs,
  screenshots, or G502 onboard-memory backups.
- To move computers: open Mouser -> Settings -> Settings backup -> Export settings,
  then import that zip on the new computer.
